description: IBM’s example implements mixed-integer linear gas-network topology optimisation in Jupyter notebooks and Decision Optimization models. It includes GasLib-derived CSV inputs and two transport scenarios. The provider is IBM Data Science Experience contributors. Coverage: The benchmark network and scenarios are study examples, without a verified real service area or operational period. Access: The public README documents a Python 2.7 and DSX Local workflow. No notebook, solver or service was run. Licence and cost: The repository shows Apache 2.0; IBM Decision Optimization and CPLEX have separate access conditions. Limitations: Legacy Python and platform dependencies limit immediate reproducibility. The simplification to a linear mixed-integer problem must be retained. For simulation it offers a worked pipeline-investment optimisation example. Related resources: The README explicitly derives its network data from data-gaslib.
